# BuildRecordPage

One page of the build history, newest first. It pages as `GET /processes` does.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | [`BuildRecordSummary`](build-record-summary.md)`[]` | The builds on this page. |
| `nextCursor` | `string \| null` | Pass it back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null when there is no next page. |
